claim.claim-text: 1. An interphalangeal implant retainer (20) for retaining an interphalangeal implant (10) and to be used with an implantation tool (30), the implantation tool (30) comprising:

2. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 1, further comprising an implant casing (25) defining an implant receiving space (26) and including a jig retaining structure (27) for releasably engaging a casing retaining structure (24) of the jig part (21).

3. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 2, wherein the casing retaining structure (27) is a groove, preferably arranged on an inner side and/or an outer side of the implant casing (25).

4. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 2, wherein the jig retaining structure (27) is formed as a slit, the slit having sidewalls engageable with opposite grooves of the casing retaining structure (24) of the jig part (21) by a relative sliding or translatory movement of the jig part (21) and the implant casing (25) towards and away from each other, respectively.

5. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to any one of claims 3 to 4, wherein the engagement between the jig retaining structure (27) and the casing retaining structure (24) is configured as a snap-fit connection.

6. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 5 in combination with claim 4, wherein at least one pair of engaging structures of the snap-fit connection is formed on a side of the implant casing (25) as a protrusion (28b) that forms a narrowed down portion at an entrance of the slit and as a recess (28a) at a corresponding position of one of the grooves of the casing retaining structure (24) of the jig part (21), configured to receive the protrusion (28b).
7. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 6, wherein the recess (28a) is a through hole.

8. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the snap-fit connection comprises two pairs of engaging structures with two recesses (28a) formed on opposite sides of the plate-like jig part (21).

9. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the jig part (21) comprises multiple retaining protrusions (22a) that extend into the implant aperture (22) from the surrounding edge of the implant aperture (22).

10. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 9, wherein the retaining protrusions (22a) are configured to retain the interphalangeal implant (10) within the aperture (22) by friction, in a direction perpendicular to the implant aperture (22).

11. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 9, wherein the retaining protrusions (22a) are configured to retain the interphalangeal implant (10) within the aperture (22) by a form fit, in the directions parallel to the cross-section of the implant aperture (22).

12. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the jig part (21) of the interphalangeal implant retainer (20) comprises a holding means (23) formed as two through holes at opposite ends of the jig part (21).

13. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the implantation tool (30) further comprising an implant guiding means (40) for guiding the interphalangeal implant towards the limb support, the implant guiding means (40) comprises a female guide member (41) and a male guide member (42), the female guide member and/or the male guide member comprises an implant holder (45) for holding the interphalangeal implant and the jig part (21) is provided with a holding means (23) that is configured to correspond to the implant holder (45).

14. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 13, wherein the female guide member has an aperture (43) facing the limb support, and the male guide member (42) has a pushing portion (46) dimensioned to fit through the aperture of the female guide member, wherein the holding means (23) is such that the jig part (21) can be held by and can be movable relative to the female guide member (41) and the male guide member (42).

15. The interphalangeal implant retainer (20) according to claim 14, wherein the holding means (23) is formed as two through holes at opposite ends of the jig part (21), wherein the two through holes are configured to slidingly interact with two pins of the implant holder (45) so that the jig part (21) can be held by and can be movable relative to the female guide member (41) and the male guide member (42).
